All confirmed. Final consolidated list of files that name the `IssueStatus` type (import, annotation, type argument, or Record key):

**Type definition & direct consumers:**
- `src/types/issue.ts` — defines `IssueStatus`, uses it in `ISSUE_STATUSES`, `CLOSED_ISSUE_STATUSES`, `Issue.status`, `IssueFilter.status`, `IssueBoardColumn.status`
- `src/types/event.ts` — imports it for `issue.status_changed` event payload (`from`/`to`)
- `src/schemas/issue.ts` — imports it for the `_statusParity` compile-time check against `issueStatusSchema`

**Hooks:**
- `src/hooks/optimistic-issues-reducer.ts`
- `src/hooks/use-optimistic-issues.ts`
- `src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts`

**Components:**
- `src/components/domain/issue/issue-status-select.tsx`
- `src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts` (`Record<IssueStatus, Tone>`)
- `src/components/domain/issue/issue-filter-bar.tsx`
- `src/components/domain/board/board-model.ts`
- `src/components/domain/board/kanban-board.tsx`

**Lib:**
- `src/lib/format.ts` (`Record<IssueStatus, string>`)

**Server:**
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`
- `src/server/db/seed.ts`

**App routes:**
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/issues/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/page.tsx`
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx`

**Tests:**
- `tests/components/board-model.test.ts`

Excluded as out-of-scope: files only comparing against string literals (`status === "done"`), files using derived schema types like `ChangeIssueStatusInput`/`changeIssueStatusSchema`, `IssueBoardColumn`-only consumers like `kanban-column.tsx`, and the unrelated `defaultIssueStatus` string field in organization settings.

ANSWER: src/types/issue.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/schemas/issue.ts, src/hooks/optimistic-issues-reducer.ts, src/hooks/use-optimistic-issues.ts, src/hooks/issue-filter-params.ts, src/components/domain/issue/issue-status-select.tsx, src/components/domain/issue/issue-tone.ts, src/components/domain/issue/issue-filter-bar.tsx, src/components/domain/board/board-model.ts, src/components/domain/board/kanban-board.tsx, src/lib/format.ts, src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/page.tsx, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/projects/[projectSlug]/issues/new/page.tsx, tests/components/board-model.test.ts
